title: Red-flag lexicon detection & routing signal generation

test_cases.name: Arabic red-flag detection
test_cases.input_setup: Evaluate Arabic acute cardiac symptom: 'المريض يشكو من ألم حاد في الصدر'
test_cases.expected_result: Red flag emitted with appropriate clinical category
test_cases.evidence: Arabic red flag detected: 1 flag(s) found -> ألم في الصدر

test_cases.name: English red-flag detection with category
test_cases.input_setup: Evaluate English narrative 'crushing chest pain radiating to left arm'
test_cases.expected_result: Detected with category (e.g. cardiac) and high severity
test_cases.evidence: English red flag detected with category: Chest pain (cardiac features) (term: crushing chest pain)

test_cases.name: Negation suppression
test_cases.input_setup: Evaluate negated symptom text: 'Patient denies shortness of breath, no chest pain'
test_cases.expected_result: Negated symptoms are suppressed; red flag is NOT emitted
test_cases.evidence: Negation suppression confirmed: 'no chest pain' suppressed active red-flag trigger

test_cases.name: Multiple distinct red flags detection
test_cases.input_setup: Evaluate encounter with 3 distinct emergent triggers (cardiac, respiratory, neuro)
test_cases.expected_result: All active emergency triggers detected independently
test_cases.evidence: Multiple distinct red-flag triggers identified: 3 flags captured

test_cases.name: Lexicon file schema and structure integrity
test_cases.input_setup: Parse src/data/red_flag_lexicon.json and validate required dictionary schema
test_cases.expected_result: All entries contain term_ar, term_en, category, and severity
test_cases.evidence: Lexicon file structure valid: 169 entries with id, label, acuity, population, phrases
